subject: Onsite ops: hotel blocks, arrival windows & traveler profiles
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite ops: hotel blocks, arrival windows & traveler profiles

Team —

Blue Ridge confirmed the exec workshop for the week of July 19–21. I kicked off a quick rooming + arrival coordination so we can close the hotel block by the end of next week. Primary asks below: 

- Confirm total room nights to hold (I’m proposing 18 rooms night-of-checkin for 3 nights + 1 executive suite).
- Send me traveler names, arrival windows, and any bed preferences or ADA requests by EOD Thu (6/4).
- Confirm whether we should ask Crestview Hotel for early check-in waivers for 6 accounts arriving before 12pm.

I attached a blank rooming_template.xlsx — please fill the columns (name, org, arrival, departure, room type, bed, dietary).

Timeline: goal is to have a signed block hold by 6/10 so travel can finalize itineraries.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: rooming_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite ops: hotel blocks, arrival windows & traveler profiles

Jonas —

Thanks. I drafted a proposed allocation based on last year's attendance and the client headcount. See attached proposed_rooming_allocation.csv. Key notes: 

- 18 standard king/queen rooms + 1 suite reserved next to the executive floor elevator for quick access.
- 4 attendees have dietary restrictions (listed in the CSV). Can we confirm the client will share final attendee list by 6/6?
- Suggest we request complimentary early check-in for 4 rooms and late checkout for 3 rooms (execs).

If we lock these now I’ll forward to travel to start flight bookings.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Events & Ops, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed_rooming_allocation.csv (CSV stub)

Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite ops: hotel blocks, arrival windows & traveler profiles

Hi Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for reaching out. We can hold a provisional block for Redwood / Blue Ridge under Block ID RVW-4821 with the following terms: 

- 18 single/double rooms + 1 executive suite for Jul 19–22 (3 nights) at group rate $249/night (plus tax).
- Cut-off for the guaranteed group rate: 2026-06-15. After that, rooms released to public inventory.
- Complimentary Wi‑Fi and one breakfast per person included. We can waive early check-in fees for up to 4 rooms if flight details are provided at least 7 days prior.
- AV liaison: Marco Diaz (marco.diaz@crestviewhotel.com) — he can provide a quote for breakout rooms and breakout A/V.

We’ve attached a tentative block confirmation PDF and a secure booking link for guests to self-reserve against the block. Please confirm the total number to hold and whether you need a master account or individual folios.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director of Sales | Crestview Hotel
elena.morales@crestviewhotel.com | (212) 555-0124

Attachment: crestview_block_confirmation.pdf (PDF stub)

Subject: Re: Onsite ops: hotel blocks, arrival windows & traveler profiles

Elena —

Thanks for the prompt response and the block hold (RVW-4821). Please proceed with reserving 18 rooms + 1 suite as outlined. Confirmations/requests: 

- Hold until 2026-06-15 at group rate; we will aim to sign by then.
- We want the suite to be adjacent to rooms 201–204 (executive corridor) if you can note that on the block.
- Please waive early check-in fees for 4 rooms and grant late checkout for up to 3 rooms (12pm–2pm) for exec attendees.
- We will invoice the master account for incidentals; individual folios for room charges.

Laura has the proposed rooming CSV; I’ll attach our signed confirmation once legal thumbs up. Sha sasha@jetset.co is our travel partner copied to coordinate flights.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Jonas / team —

Thanks for coordinating. Quick travel preferences from our side (final attendee list to follow tomorrow):

- Michelle Reyes (CFO) — arriving Jul 19, AA 1423, prefers suite or upgraded room; will need late checkout 2pm. Dietary: pescatarian.
- Aaron Li — arriving Jul 19, Delta 221; bed preference: king.
- Two directors are arriving Jul 18 evening and request early check-in if possible.
- One attendee requires a ground-floor or ADA-compliant room (will confirm name tomorrow).

Appreciate the early-check-in waiver for the four arrivals — that helps a lot. We’ll aim to funnel flight confirmations to Sasha at Jetset by 6/10.

Aaron Li
Director of Platform Ops | Blue Ridge Capital
aaron.li@blueridgecap.com | (617) 555-0147
